title: squareform
summary: Convert between condensed distance vectors and square distance matrices.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host before conversion.

description: `squareform` converts a condensed pairwise-distance vector into a square symmetric matrix, or converts a square symmetric distance matrix back into condensed form.
behaviors: Vector inputs must have length `n*(n-1)/2` for an integer `n`.
Matrix inputs must be square, symmetric, and have a zero diagonal.
Condensed vectors use the same pair ordering as `pdist`.

examples.output: M is a 3-by-3 symmetric matrix with zeros on the diagonal.
The input is interpreted as a condensed distance vector.

faqs.question: Why does a matrix input need a zero diagonal?
faqs.answer: A distance matrix represents distance from each observation to itself on the diagonal, which must be zero for condensed conversion.
